metadata.description: Reusable AI-engineering framework for Claude Code: spec-first workflow, quality skills, reviewer subagents, and enforcement templates (CI gates, hooks).

plugins.name: ai-eng-framework
plugins.description: Lean core: lifecycle skills (spec -> design -> implement -> qa -> deploy), quality skills (review-change, unit-testing, secure-coding), 3 core reviewer subagents, and enforcement templates (CI quality gates, opt-in hooks).

plugins.name: ai-eng-reviewers-extended
plugins.description: Optional: additional specialized reviewer/advisor subagents. Install only when a project needs them.
